senses.gloss:
bhúvana, n.
 —1. being, existence;
 —2.
world;
 —3. with víśva: sing., tout lc
monde; pl., all beings. [√bhū, 1150.
2c.]

bhuvana-traya, n. world-triad, i. e.
heaven and atmosphere and earth.

bhúvas, the second of the so-called “utterances”
(see vyāhṛti), bhuvas !, interpreted
as air or atmosphere, on account of its
position between bhūr and svar. [prob.
nothing more than the voe. pl. of bhū́,
‘O ye spaces.’]
